notes: Original incomplete/failed outcomes, focus/IPC and other method reasons, and strict eligibility are retained. Numeric observations do not make a trial eligible.
All graphics/frame counts describe whole captures; frame counts are STARTFRAME/ENDFRAME protocol headers rather than client presentation or pixels.
Both incomplete final Graphics-message errors remain explicit. Separate TLS-only authentication does not bypass session selection or Graphics framing validation.
Physical-interface captures include packets before relay treatment, so authentication alone does not prove exact client delivery or measurement-window routing.
There is no precise capture-epoch/controller-monotonic clock anchor. Unknown Windows flag0x200 stays unclassified in the immutable relay ledger.
Keys, compressed desktop data, plaintext payloads and pixel contents are excluded from this public summary.
